bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
git fetch --no-tags origin fix/video-chat-two-topic-pinned-doorways-20261123
source="artifacts/bot/scripts/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.ts"
git cat-file -e "FETCH_HEAD:$source"
work="$root/.worktrees/video-two-topic-operator-20261124"
if test -d "$work"; then test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"; else mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"; git worktree add --detach "$work" HEAD; fi
cd "$work"
git show "FETCH_HEAD:$source" > "$source"
cat >> artifacts/bot/build-gaybbs.ts <<'EOF'
await esbuild.build({...opts,entryPoints:["scripts/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.ts"],outfile:"dist/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs"});
EOF
docker build --target build -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-two-video-topic-operator:20261124 .
cid="$(docker create gace-two-video-topic-operator:20261124)"
trap 'docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
docker cp "$cid:/src/artifacts/bot/dist/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs" /tmp/gace-two-video-entries-20261124.mjs
docker cp /tmp/gace-two-video-entries-20261124.mjs deploy-gaybbs-1:/tmp/gace-two-video-entries-20261124.mjs
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check /tmp/gace-two-video-entries-20261124.mjs
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /tmp/gace-two-video-entries-20261124.mjs
echo TWO_VIDEO_TOPIC_DRYRUN_OK
